items.text: In adults with type 2 diabetes and HbA1c of 58 mmol/mol or more in general practice, does offering group medical visits, compared with individual reviews, lower HbA1c at 12 months?
items.population: Adults with type 2 diabetes and HbA1c of 58 mmol/mol or more
items.intervention: Six 90-minute group medical visits over 12 months with a nurse and GP
items.setting: The practice and neighbouring practices willing to take part

finer: Feasible only if neighbouring practices join; interesting to the partners and patients; novel as a test in routine practice; ethical with consent and usual care in the comparison arm; relevant to an expansion decision.
summary: One PICOT question for a randomised comparison.
